items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: D and I, we must run together about three weeks. We decided to get married. ... And from that day, to this day, D and I are still together.

ctx.x: Let me tell him how I met you. Let me tell him, because he ain't going to tell you that I got told you.

Maybe each one of you got a different story on that. Now, this is the case though. Well, see, when my sister went here Sadie, I was staying with Sadie, I was working around with Lawrence Togel and the different bands going around, you know, just wild, understand? Yeah. Just having my fun. And, I don't know, so I never did see the trouble. I might have seen him, but I wasn't paying no attention, really. I might have been in different places, you know, like we used to go out to what we call those speakeasers and…
